title: ラ・カンパネラ
chartNote: Re-authored, non-repeating full-length draft. Hold-heavy bell anchors, hold-constrained staircases, adjacent-lane trills, syncopated fragments, broken-arpeggio leaps, and section-by-section contour changes. BPM/offset still need calibration to the exact MP3.

designNotes.holds: Long and medium holds are anchor notes. While one lane is held, staircase notes move through the other lanes.
designNotes.trills: Short alternating bursts on adjacent lanes, with pair, direction, spacing, and start position varied by section.
designNotes.variation: Twenty 32-beat sections use different contours and timing choices; no generated loop or lane-rotation repetition is used.
designNotes.scoring: Each HOLD counts as one chart note and receives its judgement when released at the tail.
